headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: 5.3 Magnitude Earthquake Hits Nepal, Tremors Felt Across India, Bhutan, China.
Manik Saha says party probing presence of masked men in BJP election rally.
Inquiry into his old foreign visits based on false allegations, says Naveen Patnaik.
Election petitions filed challenging bypoll victory of two TVK MLAs.
Seven-member committee appointed to frame air ambulance SOPs.
bullets_ur: Nepal mein 5.3 intensity ka zalzala, Bharat, Bhutan aur China mein bhi jhatke mehsoos kiye gaye.
Manik Saha ka kehna hai ke party BJP intikhabi rally mein naqab posh logon ki mojoodgi ki jaanch kar rahi hai.
Naveen Patnaik ka kehna hai ke unke purane gharelu dauron ki tehqeeq ghalat ilzamat par mabni hai.
Do TVK MLAs ki bypoll jeet ko chalange karte hue intikhabi darkhwastein daair kar di gayi hain.
Air ambulance SOPs banane ke liye saat rukni committee tashkeel de di gayi hai.
